readings.Aries: Your competitive instinct is firing at something that isn't actually a competition. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Taurus: The material world gives you information that others miss. Pay attention to it today. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Gemini: Something you said lightly is being taken seriously. Check in. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Cancer: Safety is the precondition for everything you do best. Build it deliberately. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Leo: The thing you've been making is almost ready. Your perfectionism is the only thing delaying it. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Virgo: The thing you're not saying is specific enough to be said. Say it that specifically. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Libra: There's a choice that's been framed as a compromise that actually requires you to simply choose. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Scorpio: What's beneath the anger is more interesting than the anger. Go there. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Sagittarius: Your optimism is accurate. It is also sometimes premature. Check the current conditions. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Capricorn: Your self-sufficiency is extraordinary and occasionally lonely. Let someone contribute. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Aquarius: Something you dismissed as conventional might contain what you need. Examine it without prejudice. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Pisces: Something that feels like surrendering is actually arriving. Let yourself arrive. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
